phase_prompt.label: Phase 2: Pre-Runtime Allocation
phase_prompt.summary: They reside in the Upper Store, awaiting the command to descend, rendered with perfect clarity but separated from the world.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic close-up of The Chosen in a high-altitude, luminous waiting buffer known as the Upper Store. The lighting is pure and diffuse, simulating a 'white room' testing environment. Their clothing is pristine, and their expressions are focused and expectant. Below them, through a floor of transparent vector-grids, the chaotic surface of the earth is visible. The camera focuses on their hands resting on smooth, obsidian railings, capturing the tension of waiting.
